sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release

system.description:
You channel explosive chakra into one of your fists, before swinging out in a furious haymaker. Make a melee Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu) attack against a creature or object. On a hit, you deal your [Unarmed Damage] + 3d8 force damage.

Also, the target must make a Constitution saving throw, being pushed back 10 feet, falling Prone and being Shaken on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is Cast at A-Rank or higher, the number of attacks you can make is increased to two.
